mappings.rule: No consequential action is authorized merely by UI access, job title or model recommendation.
Database/projection state does not outrank lawful reality or qualifying evidence.
Forecast, interest and history cannot silently become committed demand.
No payment, allocation or fulfillment obligation is created without an authorized event/relationship.
Capability, capacity, offer, availability and owned inventory remain distinct.
GROW/CONTRACT/BUY/PROCESS/IMPORT decisions compare equivalent obligations; ABSTAIN remains valid.
Physical quantity creation/destruction requires traceable event, transformation or measured variance.

mappings.rule: Unavailable/unsafe/held quantity cannot become available merely through allocation or projection.
Ownership, possession, custody, control, allocation and encumbrance remain distinguishable.
Reserve is a governed designation; release obeys authority and constraints.
No single universal cost field may substitute for purpose-specific cost basis.
Savings require a valid comparable governed benchmark and may be zero/negative.
Subsidy/promotion/cross-subsidy cannot masquerade as structural advantage.
Any future price promise is bounded by spec, quantity, place, time, rule, conditions and authority.
Positive expected return cannot justify an action that violates hard liquidity/solvency constraints.
Security interests/restrictions remain visible to any disposition/availability decision.
No unauthorized double pledge or double representation of unencumbered collateral capacity.
Possession, custody, title, risk, acceptance, settlement and discharge are orthogonal.
Only actually conforming performed quantity is discharged.
Material substitution preserves original promise, equivalence/consent and economic recomputation.
Returned goods do not re-enter availability without governed quality-state determination.
Observation/assertion/inference/model output remain distinguishable.
Corrections/reversals/restatements are additive/versioned; history is not silently rewritten.

mappings.rule: Material contradictory evidence is preserved and surfaced until governed resolution.
Material decisions preserve model version, inputs, assumptions and authority envelope.
Retries cannot duplicate economic/physical effect.

mappings.rule: Stale concurrent commands cannot silently violate allocation, quantity, authority or exposure limits.
Read-model failure/staleness cannot corrupt canonical history; material views disclose freshness/lineage.
Implementation cannot amend canon by schema, default, status field or repeated practice.
